descriptions.zh: 我们的传感器检测到§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!正在发送不断重复的清晰信号，似乎为我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]编码他们语言的工作提供了绝佳的材料。有了这份天降的幸事，语言学家们心态十分乐观，坚信很快就能有重大的进展。
descriptions.en: Our sensors have detected a particularly clear repeating signal from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! that seems to offer our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] excellent material for codifying their language. They are optimistic that we will be able to make some significant progress on the back of this stroke of luck.

descriptions.zh: 我们已经成功地获取了数艘§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!舰船间对话的清晰音频讯号。在我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]还不能准确认识他们所记录下的单词的含义，但他们对于这段新的信号将会对突破带来重大进展抱有信心。
descriptions.en: We have managed to pick up a clear audio feed of conversations between several §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! ships. While our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] are still none the wiser as to the meanings of any of the words they are recording, they are optimistic that this new signal will help them make significant progress towards a breakthrough.

descriptions.zh: 我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]日渐沮丧，因为我们没能提供给他们充分的材料用于解码§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!使用的语言，他们的进度十分有限。似乎这些外星人正使出浑身解数，防止不怀好意的[This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]窃听到他们的信号！
descriptions.en: Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] are becoming increasingly frustrated at our failure to provide them with sufficient material to make progress on decoding the language used by the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!. It seems these particular aliens are doing their utmost to prevent their signals from being heard by the wrong [This.Owner.GetSpeciesEarNamePlural]!

descriptions.zh: 似乎我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]在翻译§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!所使用的语言时遇到了重大§H挫折§!。不幸的是，他们认为的语言根本就不是一种语言。[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]在[This.Leader.GetHerHis]的报告中指出，在几天内他们从多个角度的探讨，[This.Owner.GetLinguists]最终得到结论，这可能只是种试作音乐……
descriptions.en: It seems our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have suffered a major §Hsetback§! in their attempts at codifying the language used by the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!. Unfortunately, what they had taken to be their language quite simply was not a language. In [This.Leader.GetHerHis] report, [This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] states that, after days of investigating the matter from every angle, the [This.Owner.GetLinguists] finally concluded that it was in fact probably an attempt at music...

descriptions.zh: 令许多[This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]大吃一惊的是，似乎一艘属于§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的飞船已经扫描了§H[This.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!。我们对该行为出现了不同意见的分歧：我们是应该把这次冲击视为与外星文明建立更紧密的联系的跳板，或者是被认为一种警告，我们必须确保舰队准备万全，以免为时已晚。
descriptions.en: In what comes as a profound shock to many [This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural], it has emerged that a vessel belonging to the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! has scanned §H[This.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!. Opinion is divided on whether we should treat this shock as a springboard to boost efforts to establish closer ties with alien civilizations, or whether it should be taken as a warning and that we must make sure our fleet is in good order now, before it is too late.

descriptions.zh: 令许多[This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]大吃一惊的是，似乎一艘属于[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的飞船已经扫描了§H[This.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!。虽然有些人担心这些外星人可能不像我们这么友好，但人们已经达成共识，对于这种情况，我们应该加倍努力与星系其他文明建立更紧密的联系。
descriptions.en: In what comes as a welcome surprise to many [This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural], it has emerged that a vessel belonging to the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] has scanned §H[This.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!. Although some worry that these aliens may not be as welcoming as we are, consensus has already been established that we should respond to this occurrence by redoubling our efforts to establish closer ties with the other civilizations of the galaxy.

descriptions.zh: 令许多[This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]大吃一惊的是，似乎一艘属于§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的飞船已经扫描了§H[This.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!。人们已经达成广泛共识，我们应该对这种入侵做出回应，以确保我们的舰队准备万全且为时未晚。
descriptions.en: In what comes as a profound shock to many [This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural], it has emerged that a vessel belonging to the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! has scanned §H[This.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!. Widespread consensus has emerged that we should respond to this trespass by making sure our fleet is in good order with all haste, before it is too late.

descriptions.zh: 令人不安的是，似乎一艘属于§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的飞船已经扫描了§H[This.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!。我们不确定该如何应对此事：我们应当选择继续专注于与外星文明和平友好地共存，还是应该把这看做一种警醒并提高我们的舰队规模，以防万一可能的威胁呢？
descriptions.en: In a disturbing development, it seems that a vessel belonging to the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! has scanned §H[This.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!. We are unsure how to respond to this: should we choose to redouble our focus on peaceful and friendly coexistence with alien civilizations, or should we treat this as a warning and increase the size of our navy in case future hostilities are necessary?

descriptions.zh: 令人不安的是，似乎一艘属于§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的飞船已经扫描了§H[This.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!。我们应当扩充我们的舰队以保证这帮外星人不会有什么非分之想。
descriptions.en: In a disturbing development, it seems that a vessel belonging to the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! has scanned §H[This.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!. We should increase the size of our navy so that we may set about putting these aliens in their place.

descriptions.zh: 我们已经辨识出了先前我们在§H[This.ContactCountry.Capital.System.GetName]§!恒星系扫描的殖民地其实是§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的首都。我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]通过调查从扫描中获取的资料发现许多关于他们的有价值的线索。
descriptions.en: We have identified the colony we recently scanned in the §H[This.ContactCountry.Capital.System.GetName]§! system to be the capital of the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!. Our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] have found many valuable clues about them by investigating the data we gathered from the scan.

descriptions.zh: 我们现在已经有一段时间没有获取到来自§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的视听资料了。我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]发现他们似乎没有什么新的信息值得获取，并担心这条路似乎行不通了。
descriptions.en: We have caught neither sight nor sound of the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! for some time now. Our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] find they have little information to go on and worry that the trail may have gone cold.

descriptions.zh: 随着我们获取到越来越多被称为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的外星人的图像，它们不可避免地逐渐被泄露到公众视野当中。他们的外表令[This.Owner.GetAdj]的公众感到兴奋，大家已经迫不及待想要和这些外星人进一步接触了。
descriptions.en: As we began to pick up more and more visual images of the aliens known as the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, it was inevitable that these would eventually be leaked to the wider public. Their appearance has proven delightful to the [This.Owner.GetAdj] public, who are now impatient to make closer acquaintance with these aliens.

descriptions.zh: 随着我们获取到越来越多被称为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的外星人的图像，我们很快意识到我们正在与一个机器人社会打交道。这些消息被泄露到公众视野当中只是时间的问题。这些发现引起了[This.Owner.GetAdj]公众的遐想，大家惊叹于机器居然可以自行建立一个太空文明，并且迫不及待地想进一步熟识它们。
descriptions.en: As we began to pick up more and more visual images of the aliens known as the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, it quickly became clear that we are dealing with a society of robots. It was only a matter of time before this knowledge was leaked to the wider public. The revelation has provoked wonder among the [This.Owner.GetAdj] public, who marvel that machines could build their own spacefaring civilization, and are impatient to make closer acquaintance with them.

descriptions.zh: 随着我们获取到越来越多被称为§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的外星人的图像，它们不可避免地逐渐被泄露到公众视野当中。我们中的许多人对它们的外表感到惊悚，并称他们为§H“令人作呕的[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]§!”。并且，已有许多人要求我们采取措施以应对新的“[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesClass]”威胁……
descriptions.en: As we began to pick up more and more visual images of the aliens known as the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, it was inevitable that these would eventually be leaked to the wider public. Their appearance has provoked widespread dismay amongst our populace, who have taken to describing them as §H"repulsive [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]"§!. Already, many are demanding that we take action to deal with the new "[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesClass] threat"...

descriptions.zh: 随着我们获取到越来越多被称为[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的外星人的图像，我们再也无法忽视这一事实：我们正要面对的是一个机器人社会。这些消息被泄露到公众视野当中只是时间的问题。我们中的许多人对它们的外表感到惊悚，并称他们为§H“令人作呕的[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]§!”。并且，已有许多人要求我们采取措施以应对新的“机械威胁”……
descriptions.en: As we began to pick up more and more visual images of the aliens known as the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], we could no longer deny it: we are dealing with a society of robots. It was only a matter of time before this knowledge was leaked to the wider public. The revelation has provoked widespread horror amongst our populace, who have taken to describing them as §H"repulsive [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]"§!. Already, many are demanding that we take action to deal with the new "mechanical threat"...

label.en: They can't be THAT bad, surely.

descriptions.zh: 我们的[This.Owner.GetResearchers]已经在大量收集来自§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的信号取得了稳步的进展。然而，随着我们对他们语言的知识储备越来越丰富，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]却越来越感到迷惑。很明显他们不得不对先前工作的翻译进行数次重新评估，因为他们发现先前认定文字的含义事实上§H极度不准确§!。似乎[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的整体面貌和我们极度相异——比我们能够想象的差的更多！
descriptions.en: Our [This.Owner.GetResearchers] have been making steady progress gathering together a large collection of signals from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!. However, as our knowledge of their language has grown, our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have become ever more confused. Apparently, they have had to reassess their previous working translations several times after finding out that the meanings they had ascribed to words were, in fact, §Hextremely inaccurate§!. It seems that the whole outlook of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] is very different to ours - far more than we could possibly have imagined!

descriptions.zh: 尽管我们在大量收集来自§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的信号方面取得了稳步的进展，而我们在真正理解这些信号的方面的进展……被彻底压倒了。我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]已经被迫对他们先前的翻译工作进行了数次的重新评估，因为发现他们之前认定文字的含义事实上§H非常不准确§!。似乎[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的思维模式和我们相异甚远——比我们之前认为的差的更多，即使是对于外星人而言！
descriptions.en: While we have made steady progress on gathering together a large collection of signals from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, our progress on coming to actually understand these signals has been... underwhelming. Already, our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have been forced to reassess their previous working translations several times after finding out that the meanings they had ascribed to words were, in fact, §Hextremely inaccurate§!. It seems that the thought patterns of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] are very different to our own - far more than we had considered possible, even among aliens!

descriptions.zh: 尽管我们在大量收集来自§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的信号方面取得了稳步的进展，而我们在真正理解这些信号的方面的进展……被彻底压倒了。我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]已经被迫对他们先前的翻译工作进行了数次的重新评估，因为发现他们之前认定文字的含义事实上§H非常不准确§!。似乎[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的执行逻辑并不是基于任何一种我们所知的理性。这将会带给我们理解他们更多的挑战！
descriptions.en: While we have made steady progress on gathering together a large collection of signals from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, our progress on coming to actually understand these signals has been... underwhelming. Already, our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have been forced to reassess their previous working translations several times after finding out that the meanings they had ascribed to words were, in fact, §Hextremely inaccurate§!. It seems that the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] does not base its execution logic on any sort of rationality known to us. This will make understanding them a severe challenge!

descriptions.zh: 随着我们收集到更多有关§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的资料，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]非常惊讶于进展速度是如此之快。似乎——如果他们是对的话——这些外星人和我们对于整个星系具有大量相同的看法。
descriptions.en: As we have gathered more material on the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have been surprised at the fast pace of their progress. It seems that - if they are right - these aliens share much of our outlook on the galaxy as a whole.

descriptions.zh: 随着我们在§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!取得更多的材料，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]非常惊讶于进展速度是如此之快。似乎——如果他们是对的话——这些外星人与我们具有非常相似的思维模式。或许他们的意识与我们的[This.Owner.GetGovernmentName]是相似的。
descriptions.en: As we have gathered more material on the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have been surprised at the fast pace of their progress. It seems that - if they are right - these aliens share very similar thought patterns to our own. Perhaps their consciousness is alike to our own [This.Owner.GetGovernmentName]?

descriptions.zh: 随着我们在§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!取得更多的材料，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]非常惊讶于进展速度是如此之快。似乎——如果他们是对的话——这些外星人和我们具有非常相似的执行逻辑。或许在这些信号之后的人工智能与我们的[This.Owner.GetGovernmentName]非常相似？
descriptions.en: As we have gathered more material on the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have been surprised at the fast pace of their progress. It seems that - if they are right - these aliens share a very similar execution logic to our own. Perhaps an AI much like our own [This.Owner.GetGovernmentName] lies behind these signals?

label.zh: 这对我们之间未来的关系是一个好的预示。
label.en: This bodes well for our future relations with them.

descriptions.zh: 我们对来自§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!信号的语言解析工作遇到了挫折。似乎我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]对翻译中的关键假设已经被§H证伪§!。尽管这意味着我们许多的进展不得不被推倒重来，但至少我们未来的努力很可能会被建立在更可靠的基础之上。
descriptions.en: Our attempts to decode the language used in the signals from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!  have hit a setback. It seems that a key assumption our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] had been relying on in their translations has been §Hconclusively disproven§!. While this means much of our progress will have to be revised, at least our future efforts will hopefully be built upon a more reliable basis.

descriptions.zh: 我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]最近在解析来自§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!信号所用的语言取得了明显的进展。很明显他们现在坚信自己已经对该语言的基础有了坚实的把控，并且承诺他们能够很快报道进一步的发现。
descriptions.en: Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have recently made significant progress towards decoding the language used in the signals from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!. Apparently they now believe themselves to have a solid grasp of its fundamentals and promise that they will be able to report further findings soon.

descriptions.zh: 我们历经艰辛以在§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!足够的信息从而让我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]推进进程，但是现在我们的努力终于获得了一个极大的推动：我们的传感器收集到了他们数艘船只之间颇具长度的交流。我们只能猜测是他们的戒备突然松懈了一下，或者是他们的科技并没有我们怀疑的那么先进，他们只是自己觉得通信通道是安全的……
descriptions.en: We had struggled to gather enough information on the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! for our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] to have much to go, but now our efforts have received a major boost: our sensors have picked up a lengthy exchange between several of their ships. We can only assume their guard slipped for a moment, or perhaps their technology is not as advanced as we had suspected and they thought their channel to be secure...

descriptions.zh:
§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的语言看似包含了数百万看似冗余的音节，似乎仅仅只是他们古代语言残留下来约定俗成的东西。在翻译的时候，这些不必要的填充性词汇唯一的作用看起来只是用来补充语法的完整性，或者最多有一些微不足道的上下文提示作用。

幸好，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]已经缩减了他们语言中这些过时的部分，制定出了简化版辞典，这样一来我们就能与§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!进行高效的沟通。
descriptions.en:
The language of the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! contains millions of seemingly redundant sounds, apparently dialectic hangovers from their precursor civilizations. When translated, these apparently superfluous filler words seem to serve no purpose other than to add linguistic flavor - or at most have only minor contextual implications.

Thankfully, our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have narrowed down the obsolete aspects of their language, and are now compiling an abridged lexicon which should prove very useful for efficient communication with the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!.
